name: next-choice
description: next-choice repo root: unified dev/build/test scripts for backend & frontend

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start:dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
